From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: 
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo — exec availability & coverage request

Hi Alyssa / Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week — Solstice's roadmap aligns well with a couple of features we think will move the needle for your engineering teams. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute exec-level demo to introduce the product to your leadership (VP / CIO / CTO) and walk through an abbreviated technical run for the team.

Two options that work on our side (PT):
- Tue, Jul 26 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thu, Jul 28 — 01:00–01:45 PM PT

If those don't fit, can you propose one 45–60 minute slot next week? Also helpful to know: who do you expect from the exec side (VP / CIO / CTO)? If the CIO can join we’ll tailor the first 20 minutes to strategy and the second 25 to the ops/tech deep-dive.

We also recommend a short 20–30 minute dry run (tech prebrief) the business day before the demo to validate SSO, screen sharing, and the agenda. I’ve attached a one-pager agenda for the exec demo (Redwood-Exec-Demo-Agenda.pdf).

Thanks — I’ll hold the two slots tentatively until I hear from you.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Redwood-Exec-Demo-Agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Our CIO (Tom) can attend but prefers mornings PT. Procurement will want to be looped for contractual questions but generally does not sit in the exec demo.

Can you do:
- Wed, Jul 27 — 09:00–09:45 AM PT ?

If that works, procurement would like to receive our security checklist responses ahead of time; I’ve attached a working checklist on our side (Solstice-Security-Checklist.xlsx).

Also: is there a short list of expected attendees from Redwood (names & titles)? Tom wants to confirm whether this will be a VP-level presence or if you’ll be the vendor exec plus technical lead.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Head of Alliances, Solstice Systems
alyssa.chen@solstice.com
